attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Utah state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus ($100K, no transaction count as of July 1, 2025).

condition_details.condition_comment: Has physical presence in UT (office, employees, property)
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq { pop apportionment.state_code "UT" streq } over if
apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.state_code "UT" streq } over if

action_details.action_dsl: UT filing required due to physical presence
action_details.action_postfix: "UT filing required due to physical presence. Reference: UT Code 59-7-102" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Economic nexus established - filing required; UT filing required due to economic nexus ($100K threshold)
action_details.action_postfix: "UT filing required due to economic nexus. $100K threshold (200-transaction threshold removed per S.B. 47). Reference: UT Code 59-7-102" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No nexus - no filing required; No UT nexus - no filing requirement
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No UT nexus - no filing requirement. Any estimated payments would be refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate UT state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments; apportionment.has_economic_nexus == true OR apportionment.has_physical_presence == true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus get true eq apportionment.has_physical_presence get true eq or

action_details.action_comment: Calculate UT state additions and subtractions; Calculate UT-specific income adjustments
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef "UT income adjustments calculated. Reference: UT Code 59-7-105 (additions), 59-7-106 (subtractions)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No nexus - no state adjustments; No UT nexus - no adjustments calculated
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef "No UT nexus - no adjustments calculated." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate UT state corporate income tax. Applies UT 4.50% flat rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to owe tax; apportionment.has_economic_nexus == true OR apportionment.has_physical_presence == true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus get true eq apportionment.has_physical_presence get true eq or

action_details.action_comment: Calculate UT tax at 4.50% flat rate; UT income tax at 4.50% (reduced from 4.55% in 2025)
action_details.action_postfix: apportionment.state_taxable_income get apportionment.state_tax_rate get mul /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_tax get apportionment.state_credits get sub 0.0 max /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get apportionment.state_tax get sub /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "UT tax calculated at 4.50% flat rate. Reference: UT Code 59-7-104" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No UT nexus - no tax liability; No UT nexus - no tax
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No UT nexus - no tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Nexus but no taxable income; No UT taxable income - no tax
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No UT taxable income - no tax. UT NOL rules may apply. Reference: UT Code 59-7-110" job.audit_trail swap addto
